sources.name: Teschl, Jacobi Operators and Completely Integrable Nonlinear Lattices (2000), online corrected version 2017

sources.application: Weighted-space symmetrization, Weyl functions and polynomial recurrences are prior art. Their self-adjoint scalar hypotheses do not identify this original Hilbert-space operator with a scalar Jacobi model.

sources.application: The unbounded direct sum of coordinate normalizers is not a quasiaffinity. No cyclicity or invariant-subspace transfer is inferred.
